#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <iomanip>

class Solver {
public:
    static const int MAX_SIZE = 1 << 20;
    static std::vector<double> cosTable;
    static std::vector<double> sinTable;
    static std::vector<double> cosNegTable;
    static std::vector<double> sinNegTable;

    static void initTables() {
        static bool initialized = false;
        if (!initialized) {
            cosTable.resize(MAX_SIZE);
            sinTable.resize(MAX_SIZE);
            cosNegTable.resize(MAX_SIZE);
            sinNegTable.resize(MAX_SIZE);
            
            for (int seg = 1; seg <= MAX_SIZE; seg <<= 1) {
                int mid = seg >> 1;
                for (int i = mid; i < seg; i++) {
                    double angle = 2 * M_PI * (i - mid) / seg;
                    cosTable[i] = cos(angle);
                    sinTable[i] = sin(angle);
                    cosNegTable[i] = cos(-angle);
                    sinNegTable[i] = sin(-angle);
                }
            }
            initialized = true;
        }
    }

    void process(int testCase, int n, int k) {
        const int MOD = 998244353;
        std::vector<int> base(10, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int pos;
            std::cin >> pos;
            base[pos] = 1;
        }

        std::vector<int> current = {1};
        int power = n / 2;

        while (true) {
            if ((power & 1) == 1) {
                current = multiply(current, base, MOD);
            }
            power >>= 1;
            if (power == 0) break;
            base = multiply(base, base, MOD);
        }

        long long sum = 0;
        for (int val : current) {
            sum += (long long)val * val;
        }
        std::cout << sum % MOD << std::endl;
    }

    std::vector<int> multiply(const std::vector<int>& a, const std::vector<int>& b, int mod) {
        int required = a.size() + b.size() - 1;
        int size = std::max(2, 1 << (32 - __builtin_clz(required - 1)));

        std::vector<double> reA(size, 0.0);
        std::vector<double> imA(size, 0.0);
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); i++) {
            int x = ((a[i] % mod) + mod) % mod;
            reA[i] = x & 0x7FFF;
            imA[i] = x >> 15;
        }
        transform(reA, imA, false);

        std::vector<double> reB(size, 0.0);
        std::vector<double> imB(size, 0.0);
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)b.size(); i++) {
            int x = ((b[i] % mod) + mod) % mod;
            reB[i] = x & 0x7FFF;
            imB[i] = x >> 15;
        }
        transform(reB, imB, false);

        std::vector<double> reRes(size, 0.0);
        std::vector<double> imRes(size, 0.0);

        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            int j = (size - i) & (size - 1);
            double ar1 = (reA[i] + reA[j]) * 0.5;
            double ai1 = (imA[i] - imA[j]) * 0.5;
            double ar2 = (imA[i] + imA[j]) * 0.5;
            double ai2 = (reA[j] - reA[i]) * 0.5;

            double br1 = (reB[i] + reB[j]) * 0.5;
            double bi1 = (imB[i] - imB[j]) * 0.5;
            double br2 = (imB[i] + imB[j]) * 0.5;
            double bi2 = (reB[j] - reB[i]) * 0.5;

            reRes[i] = ar1 * br1 - ai1 * bi1 - ar2 * bi2 - ai2 * br2;
            imRes[i] = ar1 * bi1 + ai1 * br1 + ar2 * br2 - ai2 * bi2;
        }

        transform(reRes, imRes, true);
        std::vector<int> res(required);
        for (int i = 0; i < required; i++) {
            long long r1 = llround(reRes[i]);
            long long r2 = llround(imRes[i]);
            long long r3 = llround(imRes[size - i]);
            res[i] = (int)((r1 + ((r2 % mod) << 15) + ((r3 % mod) << 30)) % mod);
        }
        return res;
    }

    void transform(std::vector<double>& re, std::vector<double>& im, bool inv) {
        int n = re.size();
        int shift = 32 - __builtin_ctz(n);
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            int j = __builtin_reversebits((unsigned)i) >> (32 - shift);
            if (i < j) {
                std::swap(re[i], re[j]);
                std::swap(im[i], im[j]);
            }
        }

        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
            int mid = len >> 1;
            int step = MAX_SIZE / len;

            for (int start = 0; start < n; start += len) {
                for (int idx = 0, w = 0; idx < mid; idx++, w += step) {
                    double twRe = inv ? cosNegTable[mid + idx] : cosTable[mid + idx];
                    double twIm = inv ? sinNegTable[mid + idx] : sinTable[mid + idx];

                    int i1 = start + idx;
                    int i2 = start + idx + mid;

                    double uRe = re[i1];
                    double uIm = im[i1];
                    double vRe = re[i2] * twRe - im[i2] * twIm;
                    double vIm = re[i2] * twIm + im[i2] * twRe;

                    re[i1] = uRe + vRe;
                    im[i1] = uIm + vIm;
                    re[i2] = uRe - vRe;
                    im[i2] = uIm - vIm;
                }
            }
        }

        if (inv) {
            double invN = 1.0 / n;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                re[i] *= invN;
                im[i] *= invN;
            }
        }
    }
};

std::vector<double> Solver::cosTable;
std::vector<double> Solver::sinTable;
std::vector<double> Solver::cosNegTable;
std::vector<double> Solver::sinNegTable;

int main() {
    Solver::initTables();
    Solver solver;
    int testCase = 1;
    int n, k;
    std::cin >> n >> k;
    solver.process(testCase, n, k);
    return 0;
}
